name: S. Abell, Attorney & Counsellor at Law

proprietors.name: Abell, S.
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card abell_sidney (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

staff.name: Asa Rice
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 0 of this role in a law office at the typical band and 1 at the high end, on period_convention. The student-at-law, who read in an office rather than at a school. Analogue: the 1839 list's 11 students against 45 attorneys, a quarter of them. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. Seated by tools/seat_reconstructed_trades_1835.py (T-1433) off 1835_business_staffing_model#law_office.clerk; carried onto this record by tools/staff_the_houses_1835.py (T-1462).
staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw

staffing.basis: the 1835 business staffing model's band for this class, with the reconstructed seats T-1433 put in this house marked drawn
staffing.replaceable_by: a source naming the hands of this house, which retires every reconstructed seat it covers

shortfall.statement: The staffing model puts no hand about this kind of house at its typical band; this house carries 1.
shortfall.counted_here: the reconstructed hands this overlay seats. A hand a SOURCE names carries its own citation in staff[] and is counted by the attested join, not by this.
shortfall.replaceable_by: a source naming a hand at this house, which retires the seat it replaces, or the mint T-1448 ordered, which draws the rest

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Dearborn Street and nothing narrower; the anchor 'the Eagle Coffee House' names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-08-05, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read southern: Abell, S. (southern). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
